noProjectsHint: Connect GitLab/GitHub repositories so AI agents can handle tasks
addProjectFirst: You need to add a project first to manage tasks
tokenHint: Required for task listing and completion reports. Stored encrypted.
baseBranchHint: The branch that work branches are forked from and that MR/PRs target. Leave empty to auto-detect the remote default.
baseBranchTestFirst: Run a connection test to fetch branches.
testSiteUrlHint: Open in a new tab via the globe button on the project card.
labelSystemHint: 5-stage flow — Inflow → Process → Verify → Confirm → Done. Each stage uses a (waiting / in-progress) label pair. Labels must exist in Git.
labelTargetDesc: Base label IVE tracks to enter the workflow
stageProcessDesc: AI agent writes code and opens the merge request
stageVerifyDesc: Verifier reviews the code and decides whether it can be merged
stageConfirmDesc: Confirmer checks the merged change in the real environment
aiGuideDescription: Install CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in the repository so external AI CLIs (Claude Code, etc.) recognize "register to IVE" requests.
aiGuideMrMergeHint: You must merge this MR for the guide to take effect.
showToolUsageHint: Include tool calls like Read, Edit, Bash in agent execution logs
shareRoleHint: Viewer: View-only access / Editor: Can also create tasks
deleteProjectConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this project? All execution records will be removed.
leaveShareConfirm: Remove this shared project from your list? The owner's project will not be deleted; if the owner shares it again, it will reappear.
importFromProviderHint: Select a repository from your account and the name, URL, and token will be filled in automatically.
oauthAccountHint: The token for your {provider} account is managed automatically.
reportPageDesc: Generate a dedicated page where external users can easily submit tasks or report issues.
reportPageStep1: Share the generated URL on your test site, documentation, or email.
reportPageStep2: Users who access the link will see a form to submit tasks. An optional due date can be picked too — it maps directly to the GitLab/GitHub issue due date.
reportPageStep3: Submissions are automatically created as issues in this project with IVE and IVE-S labels.
reportPageStep4: If the URL is leaked, click 'Regenerate URL' to immediately invalidate the old link.
reportPageThemeHint: Add ?theme=light&lang=en to the URL for a light theme in English. Default is dark theme in Korean.
reportPageApiHint: Submit programmatically without the UI. POST /api/report with projectId, secret, and content to create an issue. The optional dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD) sets a deadline.
reportPageSecurityHint: If the URL is leaked, use 'Regenerate URL' to invalidate the old link and generate a new one. Existing submissions are not affected.
reportPageCopyHint: Pick the theme and language for your audience first, then copy the URL.
